data.name: Waterberg Carbon Co
data.description: Waterberg Carbon Co is a small South African biochar venture that produces biochar for carbon removal credits. In October 2025 it announced a partnership with Cula Technologies, a biochar MRV platform, signaling intent to issue biochar carbon removal credits. The company has a LinkedIn presence but no standalone website; scale and operational maturity remain unclear.
